integrity: Claims are supported by analytic conditional Gaussian and chi-square calculations and by a reproducible standard-library finite checker. The checker is not an infinite proof; independent scientific validation and publication-priority confirmation are not performed.
scientific_limitations: Scalar independent Gaussian random-design regression with \(k\ge2\) for the unbounded pole/ridge. Uncapped ratio step, not established capped SPS/DecSPS. Affine invariant moment law assumes independently redrawn batches; k=1 calibrated case only. No multidimensional, bounded-data, full-iteration, almost-sure divergence, or non-Gaussian theorem.
title: A sharp Cauchy pole and logarithmic ridge cost for Gaussian-batch Polyak steps
